_comment: Component batch for wcs-paper harvest (Unit U6). Each entry is one WCS component to render + harvest. SCHEMA per entry: { name, selector, route, trigger? } — U8 reads this to drive the harvest. `name` is the stable id used in Paper; `selector` is the CSS root of the rendered component; `route` is the URL/path (relative to --base-url, or absolute) that puts it on screen; `trigger` (optional) is a list of agent-browser command arg-arrays run after open to make it render, e.g. [["click","button.wcs-open-typography"],["wait","app-wc-typography-heading"]].
_selectors_are_best_effort: IMPORTANT: the selectors and routes below are best-effort GUESSES. The WCS editor requires auth + a loaded project before any app-* component renders, and the exact element selectors / editor route could not be verified without a running dev server. CONFIRM each selector and route against a live, logged-in dev server (inspect the DOM) before trusting a harvest run. The SCHEMA (name/selector/route/trigger) is the stable contract; the values are placeholders to be corrected.
